text:
olivia: Quick ping: PR #53102 ready for final review — allocator eviction backpressure + small API tweak. Need runtime + infra + security eyes. @lee @raj @emma can you take a look? aiming for a canary tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/53102

lee: On it. quick q — does this change affect the hot-path per-request alloc metric?

olivia: Short answer: no change to allocation hot-path latency. We add a throttle counter and expose `eviction_throttle` metric. There's one extra atomic inc on miss but not on the main allocate path.

lee: SG. can you paste the canary config you'll use? want to double-check autoscaler interplay.

olivia: Sure:
```
orchestrator:
  canary:
    percent: 5
    duration: 30m
    annotation: "allocator-eviction-v2"
```
We'll keep `max_batch_size` unchanged.

raj: I'll scan infra changes for the feature-flag gating (k8s patch + rollout). ETA ~2h. fyi — prefer canary window 06:00-09:00 PST to align with low traffic.

emma: Security note: the new metric is fine but the `eviction_reason` label — are those user-provided strings? if so we need sanitization. If it's an enum we're good. Also please add an audit log entry for toggling the flag.

olivia: Good catch. `eviction_reason` is an enum (OOM, TTL, IDLE, MANUAL). I'll add the audit-log entry and a unit test to prevent strings slipping through.

olivia: @ben — can you be merge steward and handle the rollout if we get LGTM from runtime/infra/sec?

ben: Happy to steward. I'll be on-call tomorrow morning and can trigger the canary + rollback if anything looks off. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by ben for 2024-06-20T06:00:00-08:00, id: canary-20240620-317

olivia: Appreciate it. I'll drop the final patch note + changelog snippet once raj/lee/emma give LGTM. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
